segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ כׇּל הַיּוֹצֵא מִן הָעֵץ אֵין מַדְלִיקִין בּוֹ, אֶלָּא פִּשְׁתָּן. וְכׇל הַיּוֹצֵא מִן הָעֵץ אֵינוֹ מִטַּמֵּא טוּמְאַת אֹהָלִים, אֶלָּא פִּשְׁתָּן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» Of «all» substances «that emerge from the tree, one may light only with flax» on Shabbat (Tosafot) because the other substances do not burn well. «And» of «all» substances «that emerge from the tree, the only» substance «that becomes ritually impure» with impurity transmitted by «tents» over a corpse «is flax.» If there is a dead body inside a house or a tent that is made from any materials that originate from a tree, everything in the house becomes ritually impure. However, only in the case of flax does the tent itself become impure.

moves.cueHe: כל היוצא מן העץ אין מדליקין בו
moves.summary: only flax among tree products may be lit

moves.cueHe: וכל היוצא מן העץ אינו מטמא טומאת אהלים
moves.summary: only flax among tree products contracts tent impurity

positions.claim: of what comes from a tree, only flax may be lit on Shabbat and only flax becomes impure as a tent
